home.title: Chosen Picachu
home.description: Tutorials on accordions, z-index, drag sort, charts and tables, built from this site’s own code, and a record of how the web got its three languages.

accordions.title: Accordions · Chosen Picachu
accordions.description: An accordion in HTML alone, the old ways it was built, what the platform gives now and the two together, and which of the three languages each job needed.

z-index.title: Z-index · Chosen Picachu
z-index.description: Why a z-index of 9999 can still lose: stacking contexts, what they trap, and the top layer as the browser’s way out.

drag-and-drop.title: Drag sort · Chosen Picachu
drag-and-drop.description: A list arranged by hand, by pointer on the platform’s own drag and drop and by keyboard, built step by step.

charts.title: Charts · Chosen Picachu
charts.description: A price line, candles, pressure and a pie built from a live trade feed, each as a story with the real code beside it.

tables.title: Tables · Chosen Picachu
tables.description: A trader’s table that keeps itself current, built in React and in vanilla script, step by step from the need.

price.title: Price line · Charts · Chosen Picachu
price.description: The trader can watch the price move, live.

candles.title: Candles · Charts · Chosen Picachu
candles.description: The trader can read the same trades as candles.

pressure.title: Pressure · Charts · Chosen Picachu
pressure.description: The trader can see who is driving the move.

pie.title: Pie · Charts · Chosen Picachu
pie.description: The trader can see who owns the session.

users.title: Users · Chosen Picachu
users.description: A roster of candidates and the form that adds one, with the platform’s own validation.

gallery.title: Gallery · Chosen Picachu
gallery.description: A wall of artworks from the Art Institute of Chicago, the Victoria and Albert Museum and Harvard’s collections.

record.title: The record · Chosen Picachu
record.description: How the web got its three languages, in twenty moments from 1989 on, each with its fuller story and its sources.

structure.title: Structure · Practice · Chosen Picachu
structure.description: How I organize structure: the element for the content, named landmarks, and the page read with its styles off.

presentation.title: Presentation · Practice · Chosen Picachu
presentation.description: How I organize presentation: two kinds of sheet, a class list that reads like a sentence, and constants kept in the stylesheet.

behavior.title: Behavior · Practice · Chosen Picachu
behavior.description: How I organize behavior: what is true and what happened, a functional core under an imperative shell, and a keyboard twin for every pointer action.

closedRoom.description: Something in this room broke. The rest of the site is open.
